svg.title: RRT-Connect trees
svg.desc: A square plot, x and y from 0 to 10 meters. Two gray rectangles are walls: one from x 3 to 4 m rising from the bottom to y 7 m, one from x 6 to 7 m hanging from the top down to y 3 m. Tag 1, the start, is at (1.5, 1.5) m; tag 2, the goal, at (8.5, 8.5) m. A tree of thin solid black lines grows from the start, and a tree of dashed orange lines grows from the goal. A thick red path joins start and goal, going over the first wall and under the second.
